plan_owner_impacts.note: Provider roster/detail tables (status, limits, models, logs) reuse headless fixtures; no new probe or auth semantics proposed.
Permissions manager rendered as roster+detail with rule tables; no rule-engine changes.
Copy Settings and rollback flows reuse PMCopy2/PMState2 restore points; no new storage owner.

settings_schema_impacts.note: Inventory records carry legacy "global" scope strings; this concept presents Project-scoped values only and hides scope as an editable dimension (packet 04).

command_id_impacts.note: Provisional reuse/alias/candidate census; nothing canonical assigned by this concept.

wiring_impacts.note: Every interactive surface traces UI source to command candidate, owner, receipt/ObservableWork, and recovery. Concept-local state never masquerades as production wiring.

dry_component_impacts.note: Reuses headless owners (PMState2, PMSearch2, PMCopy2, PMManagers2 atoms, ObservableWork). Concept-native presentation only: command index, drill panes, tables, palette.

schema_event_storage_impacts.note: Receipts and ObservableWork events emitted through PMState2 only; no second progress or event owner introduced.

migration_supersession_impacts.note: Old Settings chip/bloom/no-sidebar contract superseded by command-index + drill-down shell in this concept.
Stale right-panel language replaced by named panes (Index / Pages / Detail) with explicit breadcrumb.
No regular/yolo mode coupling; autonomy expressed via Permissions & Safety manager grammar.
Invalid inventory values remain hidden behind Details/Why-this-value; rows show only needed status.

slint_port_impacts: Web prototype maps to Slint 1.17.1 via stable model ids (category/subgroup/setting/rid), windowed virtual lists (PMManagers2.virtualList), hash-route state machines with narrow incremental re-render, bounded 2px blur on modal overlays only, and reduced-motion static states; no DOM-only core behavior.
